name: momentum-strong
description: T-022 operator packet, run A of two: the SAME build and the SAME URL (index.html?momentum=1) played WELL. The policy is six-face-aimed-run.json's verbatim (hold fire, hold right, tilt the gun up at anything above the firing line, face the threat inside a gate, jump at the lip of a hole) — the only reflex set measured to clear wave gates. What it demonstrates is not that the bot is good, it is that the pace ANSWERS: this policy keeps RIG toward the right of the screen, banks daylight against the pursuing plane, and the pursuing edge escalates above the shipped 4.3 t/s. Read `pursuitSpeed` in report.json's samples (the frozen telemetry field src/main.js already publishes); drive = (pursuitSpeed/4.3 - 1)/0.4, and the HUD's MOMENTUM meter shows the same thing on screen. Paired with momentum-weak.json, which plays the same URL badly and never leaves the floor.
